name: hcportal_addEditProduct
description: Creates or edits one catalogue entry (HC.Product) from the portal Products view. Portal twin of hcapp_addEditProduct: same table and rules, portal auth instead of app auth. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as callerParamString. Permission gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission functionKey 'manageProducts' on the kennel. Editing requires the product to belong to the same kennel and not be Removed. Never deletes — taking something off sale is @isActive = 0, so payments that reference the product still resolve. Pricing lives in one PricingJson field since the 2026-09-13 json rework (db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_product_json_rework.sql dropped PriceCharged/PromotionalCredit/UnitCost/RunCount/PhotoUrls; photos moved into ProductDetailsJson). HC.Product is defined in db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_create_Product.sql, not in db/schema/tables.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Required: the kennel that owns the product; also the token's callerParamString. NULL returns 'Null or invalid publicKennelId' before auth.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: NULL creates; otherwise edits that product, which must belong to this kennel

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: Defaults to 0. 2 membership, 3 haberdashery, 4 run package, 5 away weekend. Not validated.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required in practice: a blank name (LEN = 0, emoji-safe) is refused. Trimmed before storage.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Free text shown to the hasher

parameters.name: pricingJson
parameters.description: How the product is priced, as one JSON object (column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_product_json_rework.sql). Refused if not valid JSON. Syncs to phones. Overwritten whole on edit (NULL clears it).

parameters.name: productDetailsJson
parameters.description: Per-type rules, e.g. {"photos":[…],"sizes":["S","M"]}. Refused if not valid JSON. Syncs to phones. Overwritten whole on edit.

parameters.name: sourceJson
parameters.description: Supplier detail. Refused if not valid JSON. Never syncs to phones. Overwritten whole on edit.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Defaults to 1. On sale; 0 retires the product while the row keeps syncing.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Defaults to 0. Display order within the kennel.

parameters.name: newProductId
parameters.description: Create only (@productId NULL): the new product's id, minted by the portal ONCE per Add dialog and resent on every attempt. Unknown => the product is inserted with it; already this kennel's => a repeat, success with rowset 1 = that id and nothing written; held by another kennel => error envelope. Ignored on an edit. Default NULL = NEWID().

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always returned. Success = 0 with the reason on: NULL publicKennelId, auth failure, 'Kennel not found', permission denied, blank name, invalid JSON, product not in this kennel's catalogue, or a runtime error (logged to HC.ErrorLog).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL when Success = 1, otherwise the user-facing reason or ERROR_MESSAGE()

columns.name: productId
columns.description: The created (NEWID) or edited product id

sideEffects: INSERT one HC.Product row (create; CreatedByUserId = caller, updatedAtBias 0, Removed 0) or UPDATE one (edit; every editable column is overwritten)

Sets Product.updatedAt explicitly; HC.trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForProduct (db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_create_Product_updatedAt_trigger.sql) also stamps it with the updatedAtBias offset, so the row reaches phones either way
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (after ROLLBACK)
A create repeated with the same @newProductId inserts nothing.

codeSmells.detail: Any SMALLINT is stored (lines 133, 144); defaults to 0, which is not a defined product type.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
This SP must never delete a product; retirement is isActive = 0
changes: 1.2.0 (2026-10-14): optional @newProductId (idempotency audit P5; Idempotent writes: creates a row, client-id). HC.Product.id is a client-supplied GUID key. A create with @newProductId checks it WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) inside the transaction: unknown => inserted under that id; already this kennel's => success with that id, nothing written; another kennel's => error envelope. NULL = NEWID() as before.
